step1_analysis.description: A bias generation circuit that converts a PMOS bias voltage (VBP) into an NMOS bias voltage (VBN) using a current mirror configuration. Dummy transistors (XM2, XM3) are included, potentially for matching or acting as capacitors, though in the paper's context they might be related to a switched-bias technique for 1/f noise reduction.

paper_reference.title: Techniques for Phase Noise Suppression in Recirculating DLLs

I_bias.description: DC bias current generated by the PMOS current source (XM4)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using the square law model for SKY130 PMOS with VBP=0.99V.

VBN_DC.description: Generated NMOS bias voltage at the output node

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the diode-connected NMOS (XM1) sinking the bias current.

Power.description: Total DC power consumption of the bias branch

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the bias current drawn from the 1.8V supply.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the DC operating point of the bias circuit, including bias current, generated VBN voltage, and total power consumption. Also performs a DC sweep of VBP to characterize the transfer function.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bias Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 VBN VBN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VBN GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VBN VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VBN VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBP VBP 0 0.99

.control
op
let i_bias = -i(VVDD)
let vbn_dc = v(VBN)
let power = i_bias * 1.8

print i_bias
print vbn_dc
print power

* DC sweep to characterize VBP to VBN transfer
dc VVBP 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc vbn_at_vbp99 find v(VBN) when v(VBP)=0.99

quit
.endc
.end
